newsitem.title: USA: Explosives found in New York, three arrested.
newsitem.headline: Explosives found in New York, three arrested.

text.p: Three people were arrested on Thursday after police found explosive devices in an early morning raid on a New York apartment, officials said.
Mayor Rudolph Giuliani said the three men taken into custody were of "Middle Eastern origin" but he gave no further details.

"When they (the police) entered they found three individuals inside, a confrontation then started, police shot two of the individuals and then found devices inside," Giuliani told reporters near the site of the raid in Brooklyn.
He said the injuries of the two wounded men were not life-threatening and all three were under arrest. Police said the raid was ordered after they received a tip-off.
Giuliani said explosives experts were trying to determine whether the devices were active explosives or bomb components.
No further details were immediately available.
About 90 people were evacuated from four blocks of the Park Slope residential neighbourhood in Brooklyn and subway services were diverted, officials said.
